messages.subject: renjin / Bioconductor and /etc/repositories
parts:
Trying to use renjin - as a test - to use some of the Bioconductor functionality.

Just trying this first through the REPL - the install of Bioconductor looks like

> source("http://bioconductor.org/biocLite.R")

which at first errors out with an unreported Java stacktrace on missing HTTPClient class - I added the dependency and tried again.
This time, I got a filesystem error

"file:///home/brian/Projects/renjin-test/renjin-read-only/core/target/classes/org/renjin/etc/repositories" because it is a not a file.

in .read_repositories (from tools)

and then it updates the /etc/repositories file in order to load the bioconductor packages from there with install.packages

any thoughts on how to work around this? do I need to set R_HOME to something else?

Brian
